blurb: Cruz Blanca offers a taquería menu centered around a wood-fired grill with tacos, Cali burritos, and 14-inch tlayudas. They brew a range of beers in-house from Mexican-style lagers to tropical ales and barrel-aged releases. Margaritas are shaken to order alongside a full bar focused on agave spirits.
